current_reference_semantics.potential_transpiration: Global T_p supplied by the admitted restricted reference ET chain.
current_reference_semantics.root_distribution: For fine rooted compartment n, potential sink is Delta f_n * T_p, where Delta f_n is the increment in cumulative root fraction.
current_reference_semantics.drought_threshold: h3 is a deterministic function of T_p and the frozen h3L/h3H/ADCRL/ADCRH parameters.
current_reference_semantics.drought_factor: alpha(h)=0 for h<h4; alpha(h)=(h4-h)/(h4-h3) for h4<=h<=h3; alpha(h)=1 for h>h3.
current_reference_semantics.process_state: The root process reads pressure head from the committed hydraulic view.
current_reference_semantics.trial_semantics: After root uptake is evaluated, the concrete b110_root_sink_provider_t carries the resulting prescribed finite sink vector through the Richards trial without reevaluating it from trial pressure head/water content.
current_reference_semantics.water_balance: Actual root sink is one physical withdrawal. Reported actual uptake/transpiration is attribution of the same withdrawal, not a second mass term.

prescribed_sink_projection.coarse_layer_I: Any retained layer containing fine rooted compartments n in I.
prescribed_sink_projection.coarse_balance: dS_I/dt = q_top,I - q_bottom,I - Q_root,I plus any other admitted sources/sinks.
prescribed_sink_projection.interpretation: If the fine/root sink vector is supplied externally, conservative aggregation into any retained partition is exact and adds no new hydrological closure.
prescribed_sink_projection.supporting_authority: PPA-ROOT-HYD01/HYD02 already establish that the admitted prescribed root provider is physically equivalent to the same fixed sink vector carried through a generic source/sink route, and its direct trial/coupling derivative is zero.

predicted_feedback_contract.coarse_potential_fraction: Delta F_I = sum_{n in I} Delta f_n can be aggregated exactly from the root distribution.
predicted_feedback_contract.exact_actual_layer_uptake: Q_root,I = T_p * sum_{n in I} Delta f_n * alpha(h_n).
predicted_feedback_contract.required_quantity: A_I = [sum Delta f_n * alpha(h_n)] / Delta F_I for Delta F_I>0.
predicted_feedback_contract.statement: A_I is a root-fraction-weighted nonlinear functional of the within-layer pressure-head distribution.
predicted_feedback_contract.reason: S_I fixes an integral of theta, not the root-fraction-weighted distribution of h relative to h4 and h3. Distinct fine pressure profiles can share exactly the same layer storage but place different root fractions in dry, transition and unstressed branches.
predicted_feedback_contract.reason_mean_head: Unless root weights match the averaging measure and all fine heads lie on one linear branch, alpha(mean h) does not equal the root-weighted mean alpha(h).
predicted_feedback_contract.reason_first_moment: The centered water-content moment constrains vertical asymmetry under geometric weighting. Feddes uptake uses root-fraction weighting and branch thresholds in pressure head, so S/M do not in general determine the required root-weighted branch occupancy and transition-head moment.

define: F_wet,I = sum Delta f_n over h_n > h3
F_trans,I = sum Delta f_n over h4 <= h_n <= h3
H_trans,I = sum Delta f_n * h_n over h4 <= h_n <= h3
exact_branch_decomposition.implication: For the frozen drought-only Feddes law, exact feedback is determined by root-weighted branch occupancy plus a root-weighted transition head moment, not by layer storage alone.

special_cases.fully_unstressed: If all rooted sublocations in I satisfy h>h3, Q_root,I=T_p*Delta F_I and no hydraulic sublayer information is needed.
special_cases.fully_wilted: If all satisfy h<h4, Q_root,I=0 and no additional sublayer information is needed.
special_cases.all_transition: If all satisfy h4<=h<=h3, root-weighted mean pressure head is sufficient for Q_root,I at fixed T_p.
special_cases.mixed_branches: Branch fractions and transition head moment are required for exact uptake.

representation_consequence.purpose_dependence: Root-uptake feedback introduces a new purpose-specific information functional that is different from groundwater flux and geometric soil-state profile metrics.
representation_consequence.implication_for_existing_LARE: Before free-running ET/drought comparison, quantify whether existing layer-average storage states leave material ambiguity in Q_root under admissible fine states.
representation_consequence.relation_to_C6N2: C6N2 already shows surface-state fidelity depends strongly on placement. C6O adds that root uptake weights the profile by the root distribution and stress thresholds, so the best state placement for soil-moisture RMSE need not be sufficient for ET feedback.

next_authority.question: For frozen B01/B14 constitutive laws, root distributions and drought-only Feddes parameters, how much actual uptake ambiguity remains among fine pressure-head profiles that project to the same existing Layer-ROM storage state?
requirements: Use paired fine profiles with exactly matched coarse layer storages before evaluating uptake.
Freeze root distributions, T_p levels and Feddes thresholds before evaluating ambiguity.
Test multiple existing partitions including lower-zone and uniform/top controls; do not create a new partition from the result.
Report uptake ambiguity separately from profile/state error.
Optionally diagnose whether adding the already-derived centered first water-content moment removes ambiguity, but do not select a new dynamic family from this test.
No ET application tolerance, performance screen or production claim.
